name: Agent Progress for Superpowers
description: Requires Superpowers. Shows where each Superpowers plan stands, read from its spec, plan and ledger: the current workspace's tasks and agent, the other work in progress, and the stage in the status bar.

cover.alt: The Agent Progress panel in Orca: a stage strip, a progress bar and the task list of a plan, beside a table of the other workspaces with live work.

screenshots.alt: The dark Agent Progress panel: two plans, one at the Tasks stage with a task in a fix round, one at the Review stage with every task done.
screenshots.caption: Every plan, stage by stage

screenshots.alt: The same two plans in Orca's light theme.
screenshots.caption: Follows Orca's theme

screenshots.alt: A panel with an agent that needs you, in amber, next to a table of other workspaces where one agent is waiting for you and another is working.
screenshots.caption: See at a glance who needs you
